study type: Secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Time of amniotomy (before oxytocin, 0-2 hours after, 2-4 hours after, 4-6 hours after, 6-8 hours after, 8-10 hours after)
Timing of amniotomy during labor induction
cohort: 2854 term, nulliparous women undergoing labor induction
finding: Amniotomy performed 6 to <8 hours after oxytocin initiation was associated with lower odds of cesarean delivery compared to no amniotomy.
